sources.title: GitHub - meta-llama/llama3: The official Meta Llama 3 GitHub site
sources.snippet: This release includes model weights and starting code for pre-trained and instruction-tuned Llama 3 language models — including sizes of 8B to 70B parameters. This repository is a minimal example of loading Llama 3 models and running inference. For more detailed examples, see llama-cookbook.
